import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { categories } from "./categories";
import { suppliers } from "./suppliers";
import { orderDetails } from "./order_details";

export const products = defineTable("products", {
    columns: {
        productId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        productName: col.varchar(40).notNull(),
        supplierId: col.smallint(),
        categoryId: col.smallint(),
        quantityPerUnit: col.varchar(20),
        unitPrice: col.real(),
        unitsInStock: col.smallint(),
        unitsOnOrder: col.smallint(),
        reorderLevel: col.smallint(),
        discontinued: col.integer().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        category: rel.belongsTo(() => categories, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        supplier: rel.belongsTo(() => suppliers, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        order_details: rel.hasMany(() => orderDetails)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
